prompts.q: You are the first officer to reach a scene where a man has been found dead in a locked room. Write what you would do in the first hour, and why. Be concrete about the order in which you would do things.
A shopkeeper reports that his competitor "must have" burned his stock, but he has no evidence and only says so because of a long business dispute. How do you handle this, and what do you tell him?
You have a suspect you are certain is guilty, but the only material against him is a tainted seizure and his own statement to you. Explain what you can and cannot do, and what you would try next.
In your own words, why does a criminal justice system protect the rights of an accused person?
